Good to know
Terms:
month-to-month, 6-month, or 12-month — you choose at signup.
Refundable security deposit:
required, refunded when the appliance is returned in good condition.
Optional damage waiver:
available if you'd rather not put down a deposit.
Sales tax:
plus sales tax for your service address, shown on your invoice.
Late fee:
a grace period of 5 days applies before any late fee.
